name: The Estuary · Initial compositions

production.resource_scope: Parent samples every two seconds; peaks are observed samples, not continuous maxima.

resources.qualification_scope: Native2048, three pigments, one optical view on this16GiB experimentGPU

browser_review.scope: All ten seeds checked for images and previews; representative distinct films exercised in the browser. All 70 film URLs independently checked for byte-range access, and all 60 new films have complete decode evidence.

runtime_identity_hash_format: SHA-256 of common.encoded(plan.runtime): sorted JSON, indent=2, final newline.
study_scope: Ten RC1 seeds and six starting-paint setups. Source, palette, simulation rules, per-pigment amounts, lighting, camera and complete film timeline are held fixed. New material identities are expected.

validation.media_verification: Complete decode receipts plus independently checked movie, frame, source and artifact associations for every case.

native_poster_screen.method: RGB difference above 8 code values from corner background; screening heuristic, not an alpha-support proof

final_publisher_server.skip_reason: Node unavailable; JavaScript test passed locally and real browser checks supplement it
